scenario_enrichment.summary: Added source-safe scenario showing CAS as lifecycle coordination rather than a promise that the architect personally performs every service.
scenario_enrichment.scenario_excerpt: An owner wants one professional lead to coordinate feasibility inputs, design, specialist consultants, supervision, construction management, and post-occupancy support for a complex project. In SPP 206 terms, that points to Comprehensive Architectural Services and project management. The architect remains the prime professional, creator, author, and coordinator of the building design, but the source-safe boundary is that the architect is not expected to personally perform every service. Architects, engineers, contractors, and other consultants still keep their own duties while the project manager coordinates time, cost, quality, and the full service continuum.
